name: Binance Spot BTCUSDT displayed best quote
description: Normalized Binance Spot `btcusdt@bookTicker` messages: the displayed best bid and ask price and quantity, republished by the venue on every best-quote change. This is the Binance analogue of the Coinbase and Kraken ticker's displayed best quote and is the single quote source for every Binance quote-driven identity; the depth20 top of book is deliberately NOT used as a second quote source, because one identity never has two quote inputs. The spot bookTicker payload carries no venue clock, so event_time_basis is receipt and event_time is the local receipt time; order_book_update_id is the ordering key and is strictly increasing (a duplicate or lower id is dropped). If the observed-contract pass (PIPELINE gate 4) finds an engine timestamp on the live payload, this definition is amended to carry it and event_time_basis gains the source variant; until an observed payload proves it, the field is not declared. Rights-gated: the Binance row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md defers commercial redistribution, and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists binance (R7). Wire contract status (E45b): the live book-ticker payload was absent from the wave-A capture, so this stream's contract was documented ahead of observation; it is now observed and confirmed against a fresh gated Binance spot capture (binance-spot-r2-20260903T235740Z, 2026-09-03, 454344 `btcusdt@bookTicker` frames), whose payload carries exactly the u/s/b/B/a/A best-bid and best-ask price-and-size fields this definition normalizes and no engine timestamp, so event_time_basis stays receipt.
